[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Jane Shutter Glasgow, daughter of William, died 21 April 1799 aged nine months;

She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-3324|William Glasgow]] and [[Stewart-72380|Elizabeth Unknown]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3324]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The Larne monument transcription in Ulster Journal of Archaeology6(1900), p.47 identifies Jane Shutter in William and Elizabeth Glasgow’s family, alongside William’s 1816 death. The death entry 21 April 1799 aged 9 months defines this child independently of speculative later matches.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Compare the original stone and William’s 1815 will, PRONI D300/1/5/49.

Source basis already held: [https://archive.org/details/ulsterjournalofa06ulstiala/page/47/mode/1up "Armorial Sculptured Stones of the County Antrim," Ulster Journal of Archaeology, second series, vol. 6 (1900), p. 47, Glasgow inscriptions; page image (https://archive.org/details/ulsterjournalofa06ulstiala/page/47/mode/1up).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
